source: The preset for Chrome and WebExtension locales. It reads _locales/*/messages.json, getMessage calls and __MSG_name__ references.
text: 適用於 Chrome 與 WebExtension 語系的預設集。它會讀取 _locales/*/messages.json、getMessage 呼叫以及 __MSG_name__ 參照。
